constraint_results.judge_reason: While the code correctly implements LRU eviction by finding the connection with the oldest last_used_at using min() and removing it, it does not emit any metric via orgops.metrics.emit(). The idle_seconds value is calculated but never used to emit the pool.connection.evicted metric as required.
